spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m5p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Blocks == {"b1", "b2"}
Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Quorum == 2
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES pending, approvals, applied, epoch
vars == << pending, approvals, applied, epoch >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ pending \subseteq Blocks
    /\ approvals \in [Blocks -> SUBSET Controllers]
    /\ applied \subseteq Blocks
    /\ epoch \in 1..MaxEpoch

Init ==
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ approvals = [b \in Blocks |-> {}]
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ epoch = 1

Request(b) ==
    /\ b \notin pending
    /\ b \notin applied
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED << approvals, applied, epoch >>

Vote(b, c) ==
    /\ b \in pending
    /\ c \notin approvals[b]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![b] = approvals[b] \cup {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << pending, applied, epoch >>

Apply(b) ==
    /\ b \in pending
    /\ Cardinality(approvals[b]) >= Quorum
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {b}
    /\ pending' = pending \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED << approvals, epoch >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ approvals' = [b \in Blocks |-> IF b \in pending THEN {} ELSE approvals[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << pending, applied >>

Clear(b) ==
    /\ b \in applied
    /\ applied' = applied \ {b}
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << pending, epoch >>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Request(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, c \in Controllers : Vote(b, c)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Apply(b)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Clear(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AuthorizedApply ==
    \A b \in Blocks : b \in applied => Cardinality(approvals[b]) >= Quorum
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuthorizedApply
nl:
A subway signalling block system applies a signal change to a block only after a
quorum of the current controllers has approved it. Change requests wait in an
unordered pending set and their approval votes arrive asynchronously and can be
reordered. When the system undergoes an epoch-numbered reconfiguration, any votes
already gathered for still-pending blocks are stale and are discarded, so a change
can never be applied on the strength of stale approvals. An applied change may
later be cleared, resetting its approvals. Actions: request a signal change
(reorderable), cast a controller approval vote, apply a change that has quorum,
reconfigure to a new epoch (discarding stale pending votes), clear an applied
change.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every applied signal change is backed by at least a quorum of
current approval votes, so no change is ever applied by an unauthorized or stale
set of controllers.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m5p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Regions == {"r1", "r2"}
Controllers == {"a", "b", "c"}
Quorum == 2
none == "none"

VARIABLES grant, candidate, votes, shedding, delay
vars == << grant, candidate, votes, shedding, delay >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ grant \in Regions \cup {none}
    /\ candidate \in Regions \cup {none}
    /\ votes \subseteq Controllers
    /\ shedding \in [Regions -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ delay \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ grant = none
    /\ candidate = none
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ shedding = [r \in Regions |-> FALSE]
    /\ delay = 0

Propose(r) ==
    /\ candidate = none
    /\ grant = none
    /\ candidate' = r
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << grant, shedding, delay >>

Vote(x) ==
    /\ candidate # none
    /\ x \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {x}
    /\ UNCHANGED << grant, candidate, shedding, delay >>

Award ==
    /\ candidate # none
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ grant' = candidate
    /\ candidate' = none
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << shedding, delay >>

BeginShed(r) ==
    /\ grant = r
    /\ ~shedding[r]
    /\ shedding' = [shedding EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << grant, candidate, votes, delay >>

StopShed(r) ==
    /\ shedding[r]
    /\ shedding' = [shedding EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ grant' = none
    /\ UNCHANGED << candidate, votes, delay >>

Delay ==
    /\ delay' = (delay + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED << grant, candidate, votes, shedding >>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Regions : Propose(r)
    \/ \E x \in Controllers : Vote(x)
    \/ Award
    \/ \E r \in Regions : BeginShed(r)
    \/ \E r \in Regions : StopShed(r)
    \/ Delay

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ShedHoldsGrant == \A r \in Regions : shedding[r] => grant = r
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ShedHoldsGrant
nl:
A power-grid load shedder grants at most one region the right to shed load at a
time. A region proposes itself; controllers then vote, and once a quorum has voted
the shed grant is awarded to that region. Only the region currently holding the
grant may enter the shedding state, and it relinquishes the grant when it stops
shedding. A controller may be slow but never fails: a delay tick lets time pass
without progress. Actions: propose a candidate region, cast a controller vote,
award the grant to a region with quorum, begin shedding (grant holder only), stop
shedding and release the grant, tick a delay.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A region is shedding load only while it holds the shed grant, so
at most one region ever sheds load at the same time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m9p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Cars == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Cap == 2
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES epoch, requests, active, crashed
vars == << epoch, requests, active, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 1..MaxEpoch
    /\ requests \subseteq (Cars \X (1..MaxEpoch))
    /\ active \subseteq Cars
    /\ crashed \subseteq Cars

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ active = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

Request(car) ==
    /\ << car, epoch >> \notin requests
    /\ car \notin active
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {<< car, epoch >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, active, crashed >>

Admit(car) ==
    /\ << car, epoch >> \in requests
    /\ car \notin active
    /\ Cardinality(active) < Cap
    /\ active' = active \cup {car}
    /\ requests' = requests \ {<< car, epoch >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, crashed >>

Retire(car) ==
    /\ car \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {car}
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, requests, crashed >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << requests, active, crashed >>

Crash(car) ==
    /\ car \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {car}
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {car}
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, requests >>

Next ==
    \/ \E car \in Cars : Request(car)
    \/ \E car \in Cars : Admit(car)
    \/ \E car \in Cars : Retire(car)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E car \in Cars : Crash(car)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ActiveWithinCap == Cardinality(active) <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ActiveWithinCap
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper keeps at most Cap cars active in service at once.
Cars request activation, tagging each request with the current dispatch epoch; an
epoch-numbered reconfiguration bumps the epoch. A car is admitted into active
service only if there is room under the capacity Cap. An active car may retire
normally, and a car may also crash silently, in which case it is quietly removed
from active service and set aside as crashed. Actions: request activation
(epoch-tagged), admit a requested car while under capacity, retire an active car,
reconfigure to a new epoch, crash an active car silently.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of cars in active service never exceeds the fixed
capacity Cap.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m6p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Trains == {"t1", "t2"}
Blocks == {"k1", "k2"}
none == "none"

VARIABLES holder, leaseOf, usable, revocations
vars == << holder, leaseOf, usable, revocations >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {none}]
    /\ leaseOf \in [Trains -> Blocks \cup {none}]
    /\ usable \subseteq Blocks
    /\ revocations \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ holder = [k \in Blocks |-> none]
    /\ leaseOf = [t \in Trains |-> none]
    /\ usable = Blocks
    /\ revocations = 0

Acquire(t, k) ==
    /\ k \in usable
    /\ holder[k] = none
    /\ leaseOf[t] = none
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![k] = t]
    /\ leaseOf' = [leaseOf EXCEPT ![t] = k]
    /\ UNCHANGED << usable, revocations >>

Release(t) ==
    /\ leaseOf[t] # none
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![leaseOf[t]] = none]
    /\ leaseOf' = [leaseOf EXCEPT ![t] = none]
    /\ UNCHANGED << usable, revocations >>

Expire(t) ==
    /\ leaseOf[t] # none
    /\ revocations < 2
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![leaseOf[t]] = none]
    /\ leaseOf' = [leaseOf EXCEPT ![t] = none]
    /\ revocations' = revocations + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED usable

OpenBlock(k) ==
    /\ k \notin usable
    /\ usable' = usable \cup {k}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, leaseOf, revocations >>

CloseBlock(k) ==
    /\ k \in usable
    /\ holder[k] = none
    /\ usable' = usable \ {k}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, leaseOf, revocations >>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains, k \in Blocks : Acquire(t, k)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Release(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : Expire(t)
    \/ \E k \in Blocks : OpenBlock(k)
    \/ \E k \in Blocks : CloseBlock(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

HolderHasLease ==
    \A k \in Blocks : holder[k] # none => leaseOf[holder[k]] = k
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT HolderHasLease
nl:
A subway signalling block system grants each train exclusive occupancy of a track
block through a lease. The set of usable blocks changes at runtime as sections are
opened or closed for maintenance. A train may lease a block only if the block is
usable and currently unheld and the train holds no other lease; the grant records
the block's holder and the train's leased block together. A lease may be released,
or it may expire and be revoked. A block may be opened (made usable) or closed
(removed from usable), and a block can be closed only while unheld. Actions:
acquire a lease on a usable block, release a lease, expire and revoke a lease, open
a block, close an unheld block.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a block records a holding train, that train records the
same block as its lease, so no block is ever leased to two different trains at
once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m2p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Total == 3

VARIABLES stock, transit, dispensed, crashed
vars == << stock, transit, dispensed, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in 0..Total
    /\ transit \in 0..Total
    /\ dispensed \in 0..Total
    /\ crashed \in 0..Total

Init ==
    /\ stock = Total
    /\ transit = 0
    /\ dispensed = 0
    /\ crashed = 0

Prepare ==
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << dispensed, crashed >>

Commit ==
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << stock, crashed >>

Abort ==
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ stock' = stock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << dispensed, crashed >>

CrashUnit ==
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ crashed' = crashed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << stock, dispensed >>

Recover ==
    /\ crashed > 0
    /\ crashed' = crashed - 1
    /\ stock' = stock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << transit, dispensed >>

Return ==
    /\ dispensed > 0
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed - 1
    /\ stock' = stock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << transit, crashed >>

Next ==
    \/ Prepare
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ CrashUnit
    \/ Recover
    \/ Return

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

UnitsConserved == stock + transit + dispensed + crashed = Total
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT UnitsConserved
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser moves a fixed total of pill units through a
two-phase-commit dispensing pipeline. Each unit is always in exactly one bucket:
in stock, in transit (reserved mid-transaction), dispensed to a patient, or set
aside as crashed. Preparing a dispense moves a unit from stock to in transit;
committing moves it from in transit to dispensed; aborting returns it from in
transit to stock. A silent crash during transit diverts a unit into the crashed
bucket, and a crashed unit can later be recovered back into stock, and a dispensed unit may be returned to stock. No unit is ever
created or destroyed. Actions: prepare a dispense, commit a dispense, abort a
dispense, crash an in-transit unit silently, recover a crashed unit, return a dispensed unit to stock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of units in stock, in transit, dispensed, and crashed
always sums exactly to the fixed pill total.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m2p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Frames == {"f1", "f2", "f3"}

VARIABLES prepared, committed, acked, delay
vars == << prepared, committed, acked, delay >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ prepared \subseteq Frames
    /\ committed \subseteq Frames
    /\ acked \subseteq Frames
    /\ delay \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ delay = 0

Prepare(f) ==
    /\ f \notin prepared
    /\ f \notin committed
    /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED << committed, acked, delay >>

Commit(f) ==
    /\ f \in prepared
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {f}
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED << acked, delay >>

Abort(f) ==
    /\ f \in prepared
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED << committed, acked, delay >>

Acknowledge(f) ==
    /\ f \in committed
    /\ f \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED << prepared, committed, delay >>

Delay ==
    /\ delay' = (delay + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED << prepared, committed, acked >>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Frames : Prepare(f)
    \/ \E f \in Frames : Commit(f)
    \/ \E f \in Frames : Abort(f)
    \/ \E f \in Frames : Acknowledge(f)
    \/ Delay

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostFrame == acked \subseteq committed
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostFrame
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm commits telemetry frames to a durable store
through a two-phase-commit protocol. To commit a frame the coordinator first
prepares it, then commits it into the durable set; a prepared frame may instead be
aborted and dropped. A frame is acknowledged back to its drone only after it has
been committed to the durable store. A drone may be slow but never fails: a delay
tick lets time pass without progress. Actions: prepare a frame, commit a prepared
frame to the durable store, abort a prepared frame, acknowledge a committed frame,
tick a delay.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every acknowledged telemetry frame is present in the durable
store, so no acknowledged frame is ever lost.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od11m2p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Inst == {"A", "B"}
Jobs == {"j1", "j2", "j3"}
PoolCap == 2
none == "none"

VARIABLES live, prepared, archived, prepBy, beat
vars == << live, prepared, archived, prepBy, beat >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ live \subseteq Jobs
    /\ prepared \subseteq Jobs
    /\ archived \subseteq Jobs
    /\ prepBy \in [Jobs -> Inst \cup {none}]
    /\ beat \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ live = Jobs
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ archived = {}
    /\ prepBy = [j \in Jobs |-> none]
    /\ beat = 0

Prepare(i, j) ==
    /\ j \in live
    /\ live' = live \ {j}
    /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {j}
    /\ prepBy' = [prepBy EXCEPT ![j] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED << archived, beat >>

Commit(i, j) ==
    /\ j \in prepared
    /\ prepBy[j] = i
    /\ Cardinality(archived) < PoolCap
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {j}
    /\ archived' = archived \cup {j}
    /\ prepBy' = [prepBy EXCEPT ![j] = none]
    /\ UNCHANGED << live, beat >>

Abort(i, j) ==
    /\ j \in prepared
    /\ prepBy[j] = i
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {j}
    /\ live' = live \cup {j}
    /\ prepBy' = [prepBy EXCEPT ![j] = none]
    /\ UNCHANGED << archived, beat >>

Heartbeat ==
    /\ beat' = (beat + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED << live, prepared, archived, prepBy >>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Inst, j \in Jobs : Prepare(i, j)
    \/ \E i \in Inst, j \in Jobs : Commit(i, j)
    \/ \E i \in Inst, j \in Jobs : Abort(i, j)
    \/ Heartbeat

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PreparedNotArchived == prepared \cap archived = {}
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PreparedNotArchived
nl:
A print-shop job spooler is served by two independent instances, A and B, that
share one archive pool of bounded capacity. Archiving a completed job is
irreversible: an archived job never returns to the live set. An instance archives
a job through two-phase commit -- it first prepares the job (marking which
instance prepared it and removing it from the live set), then either commits it
into the shared archive (only while the pool has room) or aborts it back to live.
A background heartbeat advances periodically. Actions: prepare a job for archival
(recording the preparing instance), commit a prepared job into the shared archive,
abort a prepared job back to live, tick the heartbeat.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No job is ever both prepared for archival and already archived, so
the irreversible archival of any job takes effect at most once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m8p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Surgeons == {"p1", "p2"}
Rooms == {"o1", "o2"}
Cap == 1
none == "none"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, active, delay
vars == << coarse, fine, active, delay >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Surgeons \cup {none}
    /\ fine \in [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {none}]
    /\ active \subseteq Rooms
    /\ delay \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ coarse = none
    /\ fine = [rm \in Rooms |-> none]
    /\ active = {}
    /\ delay = 0

AcquireCoarse(p) ==
    /\ coarse = none
    /\ coarse' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED << fine, active, delay >>

AcquireFine(p, rm) ==
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ fine[rm] = none
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![rm] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, active, delay >>

StartSurgery(p, rm) ==
    /\ fine[rm] = p
    /\ rm \notin active
    /\ Cardinality(active) < Cap
    /\ active' = active \cup {rm}
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, fine, delay >>

EndSurgery(rm) ==
    /\ rm \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {rm}
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![rm] = none]
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, delay >>

ReleaseCoarse(p) ==
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ \A rm \in Rooms : fine[rm] # p
    /\ coarse' = none
    /\ UNCHANGED << fine, active, delay >>

Delay ==
    /\ delay' = (delay + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, fine, active >>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Surgeons : AcquireCoarse(p)
    \/ \E p \in Surgeons, rm \in Rooms : AcquireFine(p, rm)
    \/ \E p \in Surgeons, rm \in Rooms : StartSurgery(p, rm)
    \/ \E rm \in Rooms : EndSurgery(rm)
    \/ \E p \in Surgeons : ReleaseCoarse(p)
    \/ Delay

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

WithinCap == Cardinality(active) <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCap
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler limits how many surgeries run concurrently to
a fixed capacity Cap. Rooms are protected by hierarchical locks: a surgeon must
hold the surgical wing's coarse lock before taking a room's fine lock, and must
hold a room's fine lock before starting surgery there. A surgery starts only if
the active count is still below Cap; ending a surgery releases the room's fine
lock. The coarse lock is released once the surgeon holds no room. A surgeon may be
slow but never fails: a delay tick lets time pass. Actions: acquire the wing coarse
lock, acquire a room fine lock, start a surgery under capacity, end a surgery,
release the coarse lock, tick a delay.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of surgeries running concurrently never exceeds the
fixed capacity Cap.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m8p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Ctrls == {"q1", "q2"}
Sectors == {"k1", "k2"}
Plan == "pl1"
none == "none"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, written, logged, open
vars == << coarse, fine, written, logged, open >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Ctrls \cup {none}
    /\ fine \in [Sectors -> Ctrls \cup {none}]
    /\ written \in [Sectors -> {Plan, none}]
    /\ logged \in [Sectors -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ open \subseteq Sectors

Init ==
    /\ coarse = none
    /\ fine = [s \in Sectors |-> none]
    /\ written = [s \in Sectors |-> none]
    /\ logged = [s \in Sectors |-> FALSE]
    /\ open = Sectors

AcquireCoarse(p) ==
    /\ coarse = none
    /\ coarse' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED << fine, written, logged, open >>

AcquireFine(p, s) ==
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ s \in open
    /\ fine[s] = none
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, written, logged, open >>

Write(p, s) ==
    /\ fine[s] = p
    /\ written[s] = none
    /\ written' = [written EXCEPT ![s] = Plan]
    /\ logged' = [logged EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, fine, open >>

Erase(s) ==
    /\ written[s] # none
    /\ written' = [written EXCEPT ![s] = none]
    /\ logged' = [logged EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![s] = none]
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, open >>

OpenSector(s) ==
    /\ s \notin open
    /\ open' = open \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, fine, written, logged >>

CloseSector(s) ==
    /\ s \in open
    /\ fine[s] = none
    /\ open' = open \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, fine, written, logged >>

ReleaseCoarse(p) ==
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ \A s \in Sectors : fine[s] # p
    /\ coarse' = none
    /\ UNCHANGED << fine, written, logged, open >>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Ctrls : AcquireCoarse(p)
    \/ \E p \in Ctrls, s \in Sectors : AcquireFine(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Ctrls, s \in Sectors : Write(p, s)
    \/ \E s \in Sectors : Erase(s)
    \/ \E s \in Sectors : OpenSector(s)
    \/ \E s \in Sectors : CloseSector(s)
    \/ \E p \in Ctrls : ReleaseCoarse(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

WritesLogged == \A s \in Sectors : written[s] # none => logged[s]
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WritesLogged
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator records flight-plan updates per sector under
hierarchical locks: a controller must hold the region's coarse lock before taking
a sector's fine lock, and must hold a sector's fine lock before writing that
sector's plan. Every write records the plan and durably logs it in the same atomic
step, so a written plan is never left unlogged. The set of sectors open for
writing changes at runtime as sectors are opened or closed; a sector may be closed
only while it has no fine lock. Erasing a sector clears its plan, its log flag, and
its fine lock. The coarse lock is released when the controller holds no fine lock.
Actions: acquire the coarse lock, acquire a sector fine lock, write a sector plan
(logged atomically), erase a sector, open a sector, close an unlocked sector,
release the coarse lock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every sector that holds a written flight plan has that plan
durably logged, so no written plan update is ever lost.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m5p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Total == 3
Quorum == 2

    /\ assigned \in 0..Total
    /\ votes \subseteq Controllers

    /\ free > 0
    /\ free' = free - 1
    /\ assigned' = assigned + 1
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED beat

    /\ assigned > 0
    /\ assigned' = assigned - 1
    /\ free' = free + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, beat >>

    /\ UNCHANGED << free, assigned, votes >>

    \/ Vacate
    \/ Heartbeat

SeatsConserved == free + assigned = Total
====
cfg_text:

MaxClock == 3
none == "none"

VARIABLES leaseHolder, expiry, clock, entry, durable
vars == << leaseHolder, expiry, clock, entry, durable >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaseHolder \in Writers \cup {none}
    /\ expiry \in 0..(MaxClock + LeaseLen)
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ entry \in [Recs -> {Val, none}]
    /\ durable \in [Recs -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ leaseHolder = none
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ entry = [r \in Recs |-> none]
    /\ durable = [r \in Recs |-> FALSE]

Acquire(w) ==
    /\ (leaseHolder = none \/ expiry <= clock)
    /\ leaseHolder' = w
    /\ expiry' = clock + LeaseLen
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, entry, durable >>

Write(w, r) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = w
    /\ expiry > clock
    /\ entry[r] = none
    /\ entry' = [entry EXCEPT ![r] = Val]
    /\ durable' = [durable EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseHolder, expiry, clock >>

Clear(r) ==
    /\ entry[r] # none
    /\ entry' = [entry EXCEPT ![r] = none]
    /\ durable' = [durable EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseHolder, expiry, clock >>

Release(w) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = w
    /\ leaseHolder' = none
    /\ UNCHANGED << expiry, clock, entry, durable >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseHolder, expiry, entry, durable >>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Writers : Acquire(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers, r \in Recs : Write(w, r)
    \/ \E r \in Recs : Clear(r)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : Release(w)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

WritesDurable == \A r \in Recs : entry[r] # none => durable[r]
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WritesDurable
nl:
A library book-reservation system updates per-record reservation entries under a
lease with an expiry deadline measured against a logical clock. A writer may take
the lease only when it is empty or expired, stamping a fresh expiry. Only the
current lease holder, while its lease is unexpired, may write a record's entry, and
each write records the entry and durably marks it in the same atomic step, so a
written entry is never left non-durable. A record may be cleared, and the lease may
be released. The clock ticks forward, which can expire a lease. Actions: acquire the
lease, write a record entry (durably, lease holder only), clear a record, release
the lease, tick the clock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every record that holds a written reservation entry has that entry
durably marked, so no written reservation update is ever lost.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m1p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Nodes == 0..2
MaxCap == 2

VARIABLES token, dispatching, cap, served
vars == << token, dispatching, cap, served >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Nodes
    /\ dispatching \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ served \in 0..2

AnyDispatching == \E n \in Nodes : dispatching[n]

Init ==
    /\ token = 0
    /\ dispatching = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ served = 0

PassToken ==
    /\ ~AnyDispatching
    /\ token' = (token + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED << dispatching, cap, served >>

Dispatch(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ ~dispatching[n]
    /\ Cardinality({m \in Nodes : dispatching[m]}) < cap
    /\ dispatching' = [dispatching EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, cap, served >>

Complete(n) ==
    /\ dispatching[n]
    /\ dispatching' = [dispatching EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ served' = (served + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, cap >>

RaiseCap ==
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, dispatching, served >>

LowerCap ==
    /\ cap > 1
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, dispatching, served >>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Dispatch(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Complete(n)
    \/ RaiseCap
    \/ LowerCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DispatchIsHolder == \A n \in Nodes : dispatching[n] => token = n
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DispatchIsHolder
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper dispatches cars using a token ring across its
controller nodes; exactly one node holds the dispatch token at a time and passes it
around the ring. Only the node currently holding the token may dispatch a car, and a
node counts as dispatching only while it holds the token; the token is passed on
only when no node is mid-dispatch, so a stale non-holder is never left dispatching.
The number of cars allowed in concurrent dispatch is a capacity that changes at
runtime. Actions: pass the dispatch token to the next node, dispatch a car (token
holder only, under capacity), complete a dispatch, raise the capacity, lower the
capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A node is dispatching a car only while it holds the dispatch token,
so no stale non-holder node ever dispatches.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m3p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Bags == {"g1", "g2", "g3"}
MaxTerm == 2
MaxCap == 4
none == "none"

VARIABLES leader, term, active, archived, cap
vars == << leader, term, active, archived, cap >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {none}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ active \subseteq Bags
    /\ archived \subseteq Bags
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ leader = none
    /\ term = 0
    /\ active = {}
    /\ archived = {}
    /\ cap = 2

Elect(n) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED << active, archived, cap >>

Archive(b) ==
    /\ leader # none
    /\ b \in active
    /\ Cardinality(archived) < cap
    /\ active' = active \ {b}
    /\ archived' = archived \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, cap >>

AdmitBag(b) ==
    /\ b \notin active
    /\ b \notin archived
    /\ active' = active \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, archived, cap >>

RaiseCap ==
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, active, archived >>

LowerCap ==
    /\ cap > Cardinality(archived)
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, active, archived >>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : Archive(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : AdmitBag(b)
    \/ RaiseCap
    \/ LowerCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ActiveNotArchived == active \cap archived = {}
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ActiveNotArchived
nl:
An airport baggage router permanently archives handled bags; archival is
irreversible and an archived bag never returns to the active set. The router elects
a leader controller under increasing term numbers, and only the current leader may
archive a bag. The archive has a capacity that changes at runtime, and a bag may be
archived only while the archive is below capacity. New bags may arrive into the
active set. Actions: elect a leader under a new term, archive an active bag (leader
only, under capacity), admit a new bag into the active set, raise the archive
capacity, lower the archive capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No bag is ever both active and archived, so the irreversible
archival of any bag takes effect at most once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m3p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
Cap == 2
MaxTerm == 2

VARIABLES leader, term, active, crashed
vars == << leader, term, active, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes
    /\ term \in 1..MaxTerm
    /\ active \subseteq Slots
    /\ crashed \subseteq Slots

Init ==
    /\ leader = "n1"
    /\ term = 1
    /\ active = {}
    /\ crashed = {}

Elect(n) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ n # leader
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED << active, crashed >>

Assign(s) ==
    /\ s \notin active
    /\ Cardinality(active) < Cap
    /\ active' = active \cup {s}
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term >>

Vacate(s) ==
    /\ s \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, crashed >>

Crash(s) ==
    /\ s \in active
    /\ active' = active \ {s}
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term >>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Assign(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Vacate(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Crash(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ActiveWithinCap == Cardinality(active) <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ActiveWithinCap
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator keeps at most Cap runway slots in active use. It
elects a leader controller under increasing term numbers, and only the current
leader may assign a slot into active use, and only while the active count is below
Cap. An active slot may be vacated normally, or a slot may crash silently, quietly
leaving active use and being set aside as crashed; a crashed slot can be reassigned
later. Actions: elect a leader under a new term, assign a slot into active use
(leader only, under capacity), vacate an active slot, crash an active slot silently.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of runway slots in active use never exceeds the fixed
capacity Cap.

---- MODULE W4Od17m5p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Bags == {"g1", "g2"}
Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Quorum == 2

VARIABLES committed, acked, votes, delay
vars == << committed, acked, votes, delay >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ committed \subseteq Bags
    /\ acked \subseteq Bags
    /\ votes \in [Bags -> SUBSET Controllers]
    /\ delay \in 0..2

Init ==
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ votes = [b \in Bags |-> {}]
    /\ delay = 0

Vote(b, c) ==
    /\ b \notin committed
    /\ c \notin votes[b]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = votes[b] \cup {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << committed, acked, delay >>

Commit(b) ==
    /\ b \notin committed
    /\ Cardinality(votes[b]) >= Quorum
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED << acked, votes, delay >>

Acknowledge(b) ==
    /\ b \in committed
    /\ b \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED << committed, votes, delay >>

Clear(b) ==
    /\ b \in committed
    /\ committed' = committed \ {b}
    /\ acked' = acked \ {b}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED delay

Delay ==
    /\ delay' = (delay + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED << committed, acked, votes >>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bags, c \in Controllers : Vote(b, c)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : Commit(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : Acknowledge(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : Clear(b)
    \/ Delay

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostRouting == acked \subseteq committed
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostRouting
nl:
An airport baggage router commits routing decisions by quorum vote into a durable
committed set. A bag's routing becomes committed only after a quorum of the routing
controllers has voted for it. A routing is acknowledged to the check-in desk only
after it has been committed. A committed routing may later be cleared, which
withdraws its acknowledgement and resets its votes. A controller may be slow but
never fails: a delay tick lets time pass without progress. Actions: cast a
controller vote, commit a bag's routing once it has quorum, acknowledge a committed
routing, clear a committed routing, tick a delay.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every acknowledged routing is present in the committed set, so no
acknowledged routing decision is ever lost.
